name: E'mo Jianding Shouze
source:
You, with no memory, are thrown into a strange space to participate in a game.
The three women, trapped here with you, will be your companions on this journey.
All three claim to know you and insist they share some kind of special relationship with you.
However, even if their stories seem to be by one's own account, the worlds they've resided in clearly have no connection to one another.
You’re confided with a letter, that there is a demon hiding amongst them…
But will you really able to find them? 

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717570/Find_the_Demon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
没有记忆的你，被扔进一个陌生的空间，参与一场游戏。
和你一起被困在这里的三个女人将是你这段旅程的同伴。
这三个人都声称认识你，并坚称他们与你有某种特殊的关系。
然而，即使他们的故事看似是自述，但他们所居住的世界显然彼此没有任何联系。
你收到一封信，说他们中间藏着一个恶魔……
但你真的能找到他们吗？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717570/Find_the_Demon/]Steam[/url]]
